rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose Cantonese noun for one installment of a TV series.

example.english: I've watched up to the sixth episode of this series.
example.traditional: 呢套劇我睇到第六集喇。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 kek6 ngo5 tai2 dou2 dai6 luk6 zaap6 laa3

rows.meaning: event or period in a life/story
rows.note: Use this for an episode understood as a personal experience or period in someone's life.

example.english: That episode taught me not to trust people so easily.
example.traditional: 嗰次經歷令我學識咗唔好咁容易信人。
example.jyutping: go2 ci3 ging1 lik6 ling6 ngo5 hok6 sik1 zo2 m4 hou2 gam3 jung4 ji6 seon3 jan4

rows.meaning: event or period in a life/story
rows.note: Use this for an incidental or memorable episode in a life or story, especially in phrases such as 人生插曲.

example.english: Those few months of unemployment were just an episode in my life.
example.traditional: 失業嗰幾個月，只係我人生入面一段插曲。
example.jyutping: sat1 jip6 go2 gei2 go3 jyut6 zi2 hai6 ngo5 jan4 saang1 jap6 min6 jat1 dyun6 caap3 kuk1
